concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-transaction-release-from-escrow-node]] - Braintree Marketplace-specific Node.js escrow release by transaction ID, with the `held` prerequisite, master/sub-merchant fund distribution, next-business-day timing, and empty-handler evidence boundary
warnings: Keep the operation scoped specifically to Braintree Marketplace merchants; do not generalize it to ordinary Braintree transactions or another marketplace product.
Do not infer success fields, returned objects, post-release statuses, or other lifecycle outcomes from the empty callback and Promise handlers.
Keep release distinct from holding funds, cancelling a release, and refunding a transaction; those operations are not documented by this page.
Preserve the `held` escrow-status prerequisite and the stated next-business-day timing after submission of the release request.
